fields.Name: AutoPopulateOrganizationFromPerson
fields.Comments: When an order names a ship-to/customer PERSON but no organization, stamp the organization that person was affiliated with as of the order date (D64). Zero affiliations leaves it blank, which is a personal order; exactly one is used; more than one takes the most recent by StartDate. Set to false to store only what the caller supplies.

fields.Name: OrganizationAffiliationRelationshipTypes
fields.Comments: Comma-separated bizapps-common RelationshipType NAMES that count as an organizational affiliation for the setting above. Employee only by default: the seeded types also include Vendor, Customer and Friend, and being a vendor to an organization must not make it your bill-to. RelationshipType is a lookup table, so a deployment can add its own type and list it here without a schema change. An empty value disables the inference.

fields.Name: BookProcessingFeeInlineForPaymentTypes
fields.Comments: Comma-separated PaymentType CODES (e.g. 'CreditCard,ACH') whose processor fee is booked as its own journal entry at capture — Dr Processing Fee / Cr Cash. EMPTY BY DEFAULT, which means no tender books a fee inline and the whole processor cost is accrued in the accounting system at month end instead (D82). Off is the correct default rather than the timid one: a per-payment fee leg cannot reconcile to a bank statement, because the processor batches into payouts and deducts costs that never attach to any payment at all - a failed-debit charge, a dispute fee, a monthly platform charge. Booking one category per transaction gives a Cash figure that is right in aggregate only if every other category is also captured, and never right on any given day. The fee is still READ from the gateway and still stored on PaymentHeader.ProcessingFeeAmount and NetAmount; this setting decides only whether it becomes a journal entry. Turn it on only where per-payment fee attribution is genuinely needed, and expect to reconcile the difference. Codes are matched case-insensitively.
